title: React state, context, memo, re-render rules

preview.what: State, context, memoization, and why components re-render.
preview.picture: A noticeboard everyone reads (context) vs a note passed hand to hand (props). Memo is 'don't repaint the wall if nothing changed'.
preview.why: 'Why is this re-rendering?' live-debugging is standard.
preview.bn: Noticeboard (context) বনাম হাতে হাতে চিঠি (props); memo = কিছু না বদলালে দেয়াল আবার রং করো না।
